guidance.title: Guidance
guidance.description: What to do with this run.

hints.noAncientSouls: You need ancient souls for this to work. Transcend as soon as you unlock transcendence at zone 300. It is worth it.
hints.firstAscension: Your first ascension should be at zone 130, so you unlock Kumawakamaru and a few other ancients as soon as possible. That speeds up every ascension after it.
hints.borbForZone: Only {borbForZone} Borb is needed for two monsters per zone on your final ascension, but {borbForFirstAscension} is needed for two monsters per zone after ascending for the first time at zone 130.
hints.borbHigher: There are more ascensions than the last one, so Borb is levelled higher to speed up the earlier ones.
hints.transcendAfterAscensions: Transcend after 3 or 4 ascensions that give new ancient souls. An ascension only counts if it earns you more hero souls than your previous transcension.
hints.estimateActive: The highest zone below is an estimate and assumes active play, which you should switch to as soon as you have two autoclickers.
hints.guidelineNoLongerApplies: The "3 or 4 ascensions that give ancient souls" guideline does not apply beyond 24% Transcendent Power.
hints.keepAscending: Keep ascending until you reach at least the estimated highest zone below. That takes more ascensions than you are used to.
hints.closeToCap: You are getting close to 25% Transcendent Power, so transcending no longer gives the boost it used to.
hints.borbOnlyLimit: You have enough Transcendent Power to reach any hero. Borb is your only limit now, and putting more levels into it is the only reason to transcend.
hints.lastFourAtZero: The last four outsiders are impractical to maintain at high zones, so they are kept at 0. This is not a bug.
hints.oneLessAscension: You can do one less ascension than the highest zone estimate asks for if you want a more pleasant run. It is only slightly worse long term.
